question.text: The co-ordinates of a moving particle at any time ' $t$ ' are given by $x=\alpha t^3$ and $y=\beta t^3$. The speed of the particle at time ' $t$ ' is given by

solution.text:
$V_x=\frac{d x}{d t}=3 \alpha t^2, V_y=\frac{d y}{d t}=3 \beta t^2$
$\overrightarrow{\mathrm{v}}=\sqrt{\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{x}^2}+\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{y}^2}}=3 \mathrm{t}^2 \sqrt{\alpha^2+\beta^2}$
